researchQuestion: Do H.4.1 release-lagged changes and complete ETH+6-alt breadth add useful early information beyond fixed BTC-only trend and structural context, given historically correlated observations?
commonPanel: Use EXACT fully closed Sunday BTC weeks from v8.9 and v8.6 in 2020-2026 with frozen full 8-asset breadth and available release-lagged H.4.1. Require observed next13w BTC price and next13w structural label for fair, same-row four lens evaluation; exclude last 13 incomplete weeks as right-censored rather than losses.
strictMacro: Within five newest dated Fed releases <=Sunday-3 days used for 4-release delta, reject any consecutive publication gap >10 calendar days and reject if any H.4.1 source page unavailable/parse-blocked occurs in that five-release window. Do not silently stitch weeks past a missing release. Macro direction DOWN/UP from baseline frozen H.4.1. Historical pages retrieved in 2026 may have been edited and are PIT_VINTAGE_UNVERIFIED.

fourModels.A: BTC-only: frozen v8.9 weeklyTrendUp on Sunday, for all observation Sundays whose structural confirmed state is NOT STRUCTURAL_EXPANSION_PRICE_PROXY
fourModels.B: A AND frozen full basket ethVsBtc>0 AND at least 4 of six alt (SOL,BNB,LINK,XRP,ADA,DOGE) outperform BTC over same past 30 days
fourModels.C: A AND Fed monetary proxy Fed assets−TGA−consolidated reverse repos changed positively across last 4 correctly dated consecutive releases

target1: Future structural expansion onset: some confirmed structural=STRUCTURAL_EXPANSION_PRICE_PROXY on one of the NEXT 13 fully closed Sundays after signal, when Sunday t is not already in expansion. This is price-derived target, no independent bull-market ground truth.
target2: Forward 13w BTC reference fixing close-to-close >0; adverse maximum drawdown if smallest next 91 DAILY closes <=-20% vs initial Sunday, all from immutable v8.6.
metrics: For each model across IDENTICAL full common panel: predicted positives, TP, FP, FN, TN, precision, recall, specificity, balanced accuracy if denominators available; no models trained, no fitted weights, no p-values. Report both structural target and 13w positive return, and next13w return distribution by signal and no-signal.
nonOverlapping: Descriptive sensitivity select fixed every 13th eligible Sunday from common panel's FIRST Sunday, regardless of feature values; report same confusion and positive outcome, warn cohort small and weekly event labels correlated.
eraSplits: 2020–2023 vs 2024–2026 only, same predeclared features and thresholds, no historical holdout claims because both eras have already been inspected.
eventTransitions: For every future structural EXPANSION confirmation within 2020–2026, report if A/B/C/D triggered in preceding 13 weeks and first trigger date from strictly as-of prior weekly observations; require full eight-asset data or mark NOT_COMPARABLE.
allEraMacro: Use v8.10.1 own unchanged 29 structural switch descriptions over 2011–2026 as background; only full common panel gives four-way comparability.
holdout: This is exploratory post-selection. Even if a group shows higher descriptive precision, no calibrated probability or independent validation. Prospective future observations needed.
qualityGuard: Exact 750 structural weeks and 814 BTC history weeks
Missing alt listings explicitly excluded not set negative
No macro source after current Sunday
One single R2 immutable versioned writeback with SHA reread
operationalBoundary: No trading signals, no positions, no changes to MASTER, Spot, Futures, NAV, P&L, reserve, capital or risk limits.
